name: tenantext
description: tenantext for Claude Code: the Simplified English hook, /ste, /spawn_agent, /handoff_coordinator and the kit skills

plugins.name: tenantext
plugins.description: A SessionStart hook injects the Simplified English (adapted ASD-STE001) output rules at session start and after /clear, resume and compaction. A PreToolUse hook denies the shell commands of the kit command rules. /ste toggles the default. /spawn_agent starts a Herdr agent pane. /handoff_coordinator hands the work to a new coordinator pane and closes the previous one. After build-skills.py runs in the kit clone, the plugin also carries the skills that the kit manifest declares for tenantext.
